## Material deliberately not minted

The scaffold cites rather than duplicates:

- Ordinary character orthogonality and Frobenius reciprocity, under the abstract-algebra seam.
- Relative projectivity, Higman’s criterion, vertex/source definitions and their existence/conjugacy, under GT-18.
- Primitive block idempotents, ordinary/Brauer block partitions and decomposition matrices, under GT-19.
- Compact-Lie maximal tori and Weyl integration, under differential geometry.
- Pontryagin duality, Bochner’s theorem and LCA Plancherel, under FR.
- Spectral, functional-calculus and compact-operator theory, under functional analysis.
- Abstract \(\mathfrak{sl}_2\) highest/lowest-weight theory, under RL.
- Deligne–Lusztig and cuspidal classification beyond principal series, modular Specht theory, fusion systems, Brauer’s Third Main Theorem, generalized character orthogonality and the descriptive-set-theoretic Glimm proof as successor or prerequisite-heavy material.
- A Green “common source” corollary and a small generalized-decomposition-number table where the read sources did not supply adequate proof/example support.

No generated theorem, definition, bridge, example or dependency target was introduced.

## Blockers and interfaces

No blocker required a prompt. The inaccessible Isaacs source was recorded and not counted; Zheng supplied the second complete Schur-index treatment.

The unresolved `RL-n` anchor and `FR-n` citations are recorded as concurrent splice interfaces. RG-28’s non-load-bearing \(SL_2(\mathbb R)\) property-(T) illustration is also explicitly marked as a forward dependency on RG-29.
